rationale: Small accuracy correction to the parent knowledge entry so that every figure it quotes belongs to the receipts it cites. The entry as recorded illustrated the three-second window with '4 -> 1193', which was measured in a receipt it does not cite (d1897256143f4de2b0477a3460ae392b), while its cited three-second receipt measured 5 -> 1197; the correction aligns each figure with its cited execution and adds the five-voter and repair-boundary numbers in the same form. The behavior claim, its conditions, its sources and the four cited receipts are unchanged, and no question, interpretation or experiment is touched.

knowledge.statement: A follower that accepts an InstallSnapshot whose index does not exceed its cached last log entry never accepts another log entry from that leader: the cached claim keeps outranking the installed snapshot in getLastEntry, every prev-log check fails, the leader walks nextIndex down until it can no longer read its own trimmed log, and it re-ships the same snapshot. Measured figures, each with its cited receipt: three seconds, three voters (execution b6089b103bbb467199d051f4492e82c8, probe index 14) restores 5 -> 1197 with the follower's applied index fixed at 83 while the cluster frontier reached 95 and the claim held at (103, term 2) with store suffix 84-103 kept; three seconds, monotonic store (execution 20c7c72772474093bd609a37b84448f, probe index 14) restores 5 -> 1102 with the store emptied to first and last index 0 while the claim still persisted; three seconds, five voters (execution 14e86faf6ccc4b13af3ee46c65cc08dc, probe index 14) restores 5 -> 1432 with the claim at (95, term 2) over a snapshot at 83; ten seconds, three voters (execution 8a3c426eb9094b3f9bd3cfb1004039be, probe index 42) restores 5 -> 4788 with the applied index still 83 while the frontier advanced to 123; and the repair boundary (execution 20c7c72772474093bd609a37b84448f, probe index 33) where a claim of 97 met a snapshot at 98, after which the follower applied through to the frontier at 109 and its claim became consistent. In every case the follower's commit index stayed 0.
knowledge.conditions: In-process stores (InmemStore, FileSnapshotStore and its monotonic wrapper) with TrailingLogs=10 against a large-trailing control, one induced partition of a single voter that holds an uncommitted suffix from a superseded leader, its restart on the unchanged stores, an idle cluster with one client write per 250 ms sample and no automatic snapshotting, three or five voters, and the leader's snapshot index remaining at or below the follower's cached claim throughout the window.
knowledge.changed_premise: Figures aligned to the cited receipts: the three-second illustration now reads restores 5 -> 1197 (the cited receipt's own numbers) instead of 4 -> 1193, which came from an uncited earlier receipt, and the five-voter and repair-boundary figures were added with their receipts. The behavior claim, conditions and sources are unchanged.
